subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should Control UI support persistent per-agent avatar uploads from the Agents tab, and should that be a dedicated `agents.avatar.upload` RPC or a constrained composition of existing agent file and identity APIs?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but accepting browser-selected image bytes into an agent workspace changes a security-sensitive write boundary and a public Gateway RPC surface.

options.title: Approve bounded upload RPC
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped `agents.avatar.upload` admin method with strict size, MIME, extension, path containment, generated filename, symlink/hardlink, and `IDENTITY.md` update tests.

options.title: Compose existing APIs
options.body: Avoid a new RPC only if maintainers first define how existing file and identity APIs can safely support binary avatar writes without broadening arbitrary workspace writes.

options.title: Keep current paths
options.body: Do not add persistent upload yet; keep CLI/manual `IDENTITY.md` paths plus the browser-local Quick Settings override while avatar route policy issues settle.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload RPC
recommendation.body: Add a narrowly scoped `agents.avatar.upload` admin method with strict size, MIME, extension, path containment, generated filename, symlink/hardlink, and `IDENTITY.md` update tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Agents page and gateway agent-method surfaces route through files recently integrated by this contributor, making them the best initial owner for the implementation shape decision.
